question: What is the total amount of the facility (total commitments)?
source_text: Acceleration: on and at any time after the occurrence of an Event of Default which is continuing, the Agent may, and shall if so directed by the Majority Lenders (Lenders whose Commitments aggregate more than 66 2/3 per cent. of the Total Commitments), cancel the Total Commitments and declare all outstanding Loans immediately due and payable.

question: When is the termination date and can it be extended?
source_text: "Termination Date" means the date falling five years after the date of this Agreement, subject to extension under Clause 2.3.

question: In which currencies can loans be drawn?
source_text: Each Loan may be drawn in euro, US dollars or sterling.

question: What is the interest margin?
source_text: The Margin is 0.45 per cent. per annum, adjusted in accordance with the sustainability-linked margin adjustment in Schedule 6 by up to plus or minus 0.025 per cent. per annum.

question: Which reference (benchmark) rates apply and is there a zero floor?
source_text: If the Reference Rate is less than zero, it shall be deemed to be zero.

question: What is the commitment fee on undrawn amounts?
source_text: The Borrower shall pay to the Agent (for the account of each Lender) a commitment fee computed at the rate of 35 per cent. of the applicable Margin on that Lender's Available Commitment for the Availability Period.

question: What utilisation fee applies and at which usage levels?
source_text: The Borrower shall pay a utilisation fee on the aggregate amount of all outstanding Loans at the rate of 0.10 per cent. per annum when outstanding Loans exceed 33 per cent. of the Total Commitments, and 0.20 per cent. per annum when they exceed 66 per cent. of the Total Commitments.

question: What agency fee is payable to the agent?
source_text: The Borrower shall pay to the Agent an agency fee of EUR 40,000 per annum, payable in advance on each anniversary of the date of this Agreement.

question: How much notice is needed to draw a loan?
source_text: The Borrower may borrow a Loan by delivering a duly completed Utilisation Request to the Agent not later than 11:00 a.m. (Paris time) three Business Days before the proposed Utilisation Date, or one Business Day before in the case of a Loan in euro.

question: How much notice is needed to prepay a loan, and what minimum amount?
source_text: The Borrower may, if it gives the Agent not less than five Business Days' prior notice, prepay the whole or any part of a Loan (but, if in part, by a minimum amount of EUR 5,000,000).

question: How much notice is needed to cancel undrawn commitments?
source_text: The Borrower may, if it gives the Agent not less than ten Business Days' prior notice, cancel the whole or any part (being a minimum amount of EUR 10,000,000) of the Available Facility.

question: What happens on a change of control?
source_text: Change of Control: if a Change of Control occurs, the Borrower shall promptly notify the Agent, and any Lender may, by notice given within 30 days of the Borrower's notice, require repayment of its participation in all outstanding Loans and cancel its Commitment, with such repayment due not less than 30 days after the Lender's notice.

question: What financial covenant applies, at what level and when is it tested?
source_text: The Borrower shall ensure that Leverage (being the ratio of Consolidated Net Debt to Consolidated EBITDA) in respect of each Relevant Period ending on 31 March and 30 September does not exceed 3.50:1.

question: By when must annual and half-year financial statements be delivered?
source_text: The Borrower shall supply its unaudited consolidated half-year financial statements within 120 days after the end of each financial half-year.

question: What does the negative pledge restrict and what threshold applies?
source_text: Negative pledge: the Borrower shall not create or permit to subsist any Security over any of its assets, other than Permitted Security, where the aggregate principal amount secured exceeds EUR 250,000,000.

question: What is the cross-default threshold?
source_text: Cross default: any Financial Indebtedness of the Borrower is not paid when due or is declared due before its specified maturity as a result of an event of default, provided that no Event of Default occurs under this Clause 11.2 if the aggregate amount of such Financial Indebtedness is less than EUR 100,000,000.

question: What share of commitments makes the Majority Lenders?
source_text: Acceleration: on and at any time after the occurrence of an Event of Default which is continuing, the Agent may, and shall if so directed by the Majority Lenders (Lenders whose Commitments aggregate more than 66 2/3 per cent. of the Total Commitments), cancel the Total Commitments and declare all outstanding Loans immediately due and payable.

question: Which law governs the agreement and which courts have jurisdiction?
source_text: The Tribunal des activités économiques de Paris has exclusive jurisdiction to settle any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement.
